 Medicare Open Enrollment is moving into its final weeks, making this an important time for seniors who still need to review their coverage for the year ahead. Carolina Showcase host Alyssa Butterson spoke with Melanie Blackston to share how Medicare plans can change from year to year, understand the importance of acting before the December 7 deadline and feel more confident seeking help.
